title: The tournament starts
text: Five models start training from scratch: PPO, DQN, NEAT, CMA-ES, Mini-AlphaZero. First ranking round in 20 minutes, then every 30 minutes.

title: PPO restarted on purpose
text: Code update before the first ranking round: the tournament now gets a small weights-only file instead of the full training checkpoint.
